1.title: Questions swirl over top US Republican McConnell's hospital stay - here's what we know
1.summary: McConnell, 84, has been in hospital for more than four weeks, and his staff have not yet said why he was admitted.

2.title: Part of Florida’s ‘Stop WOKE’ Law Ruled Illegal by Appeals Court
2.summary: The law limits teaching on race, gender and other topics. Part of the law related to colleges was struck down. It remains in effect in K-12 schools.

3.title: Haley Stevens Goes on Attack Against Abdul El-Sayed at Michigan Senate Debate
3.summary: At their first one-on-one debate in a top Senate race, Representative Haley Stevens accused her progressive rival, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, of being too focused on publicity as he called her a tool of corporate interests.

4.title: Live Updates: Trump Lashes Out at NATO Summit but Offers New Help to Ukraine
4.summary: Though President Trump assailed partners for not joining the war in Iran, he said he would grant Ukraine long-sought authority to make the Patriot defense system.

5.title: Iran Live Updates: Trump Casts Doubt on Future of Cease-Fire After Latest Strikes
5.summary: “I think it’s over,” President Trump said, referring to the preliminary truce, and threatened to strike Iran again. The two sides traded attacks as their truce appeared to edge closer to collapse.

6.title: The Alluring Albanian Island Inspiring Ivanka’s Fantasy
6.summary: A former military base in the Adriatic Sea, the island is in a beautiful setting but it is strewed with snakes, crumbling buildings and land mines.
